fikir: Bölüm 1'in sonunda pil 5 saniye yetti. Yeni hedef: komşunun kedisinin elektrikli oyuncak faresindeki büyük pil. Fare uyuyan kedinin hemen yanında.
stil: 3D cartoon style, soft warm lighting, ugly-cute aliens, same character design as reference

karakterler.tarif: small skinny gray alien with an oversized bumpy wrinkled bald head, tiny round wire glasses, huge glossy dark eyes, ragged stitched burlap vest, ugly-cute, 3D cartoon style
tiny round alien fully covered in fluffy cream-peach fur, two short antennae with peach tips, huge round eyes taking half of the face, small arms, ugly-cute, 3D cartoon style

pretty compact alien girl with smooth lavender-purple skin, two big curled head tendrils, long curled eyelashes, big sparkling eyes, full glossy pink lips, gray patched scrap-fabric top fully covering chest, fluffy patched mini skirt, pink ribbon scarf, small boots, tasteful and cute, 3D cartoon style

small villain alien, one half covered in shaggy purple fur and the other half bald pink skin, one eye bigger than the other, bushy dark eyebrows, toothy grin, red-and-white striped sock worn as a cape, ugly-cute, 3D cartoon style

small rubbery frog-like alien, lime-green body with orange belly, orange hands and feet, two thin antennae with orange tips, huge bulging round eyes, very wide mouth, stretchy limbs, goofy expression, ugly-cute, 3D cartoon style
orange-and-white house cat with sleepy eyelids, fluffy, calm and curious, 3D cartoon style

sahneler.aciklama: 1. Hedef — Pof tahtaya fare+pil çizer, Tit kedi çizimini görünce titrer (Flow'da hazır)
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only short gibberish alien sounds, no real words, no text. The gray alien finishes drawing on the chalkboard a toy mouse with a big battery inside and a sleeping cat next to it, then taps it proudly. The lavender girl and the green alien nod excitedly. The fluffy cream alien on the floor wakes up, sees the cat drawing, its fur puffs up and it trembles. Slow push-in toward the chalkboard.

sahneler.aciklama: 2. Sızma — salona sızarlar, Bubu ciyaklayan oyuncağa basar (Flow'da hazır)
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only whispered gibberish alien sounds, no real words, no text. The five aliens tiptoe in a line across the dark living room toward the sleeping cat in its basket. The lavender girl signals with her hand to go slowly. The green alien steps on a squeaky toy: a loud squeak, and everyone freezes mid-step. Slow tracking shot following them.

sahneler.aciklama: 3. Uyanış — Bubu'nun karnı guruldar, kedi tek gözünü açar (Flow'da hazır)
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only short gibberish alien sounds, no real words, no text. The green alien's belly rumbles very loudly. The sleeping cat slowly opens one eye. Everyone freezes like statues; the gray alien tries to hide his chalkboard behind his back. Slow push-in on the cat's opening eye.

sahneler.aciklama: 4. Tit'in şansı — Tit bayılır, kedi onu yavrusu sanıp sepete taşır
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only gibberish alien gasps, no real words, no text. The tiny fluffy alien faints from fear. The cat gently picks it up by the scruff in its mouth like a kitten and carries it back to its basket, away from the toy mouse. The others watch in horror, mouths open. Locked-off wide shot.

sahneler.aciklama: 5. Grum'un planı — Grum kediye meydan okur, kedi onu patisiyle yuvarlar
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only gibberish sounds and a deep evil cartoon laugh, no real words, no text. The half-furry purple villain alien steps forward, laughs dramatically and points commandingly at the cat. The cat calmly rolls him like a ball with one paw and pins him under it; he keeps trying to laugh under the paw. Medium shot.

sahneler.aciklama: 6. Pil — Pof ve Lila oyuncak fareden pili çıkarır
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only whispered gibberish alien sounds, no real words, no text. While the cat is busy, the gray alien and the lavender girl sneak to the electric toy mouse, open its back and pull out a big battery. They silently high-five. Close-up on their hands and the battery, then their happy faces.

sahneler.aciklama: 7. Kalkış — gemi pille parlar, havalanır, düşer (başlangıç: Bölüm 1'in son karesi, garaj)
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only short gibberish alien sounds, no real words, no text. The aliens plug a big battery into the spaceship. Its lights blaze bright, the ship hovers a few centimeters off the floor, everyone cheers, then it drops with a thud and the lights go out. The gray alien calmly starts a new drawing on the chalkboard. Wide shot.

sahneler.aciklama: 8. Final — gemi kapıyı kapatır, kedi pencereden bakar
sahneler.istem: Stylized 3D animated cartoon. Keep the exact characters, colors and style from the image. Wordless comedy: only short gibberish alien sounds, no real words, no text. The spaceship suddenly lurches forward and bumps the garage door shut with a bang. Everyone turns slowly to the garage window: outside, the orange-and-white cat presses its face to the glass, staring curiously at the spaceship. Slow push-in toward the window.
